name: Ootsuki
source: Ootsuki is a college professor and the foremost Japanese member of the Witch Hunt, an international organization of enthusiasts dedicated to researching the tragedy on Rokkenjima from an occult perspective. Ange interviews him in order to learn more about the Rokkenjima incident.
